tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, dialogs, inputs, text areas, secondary buttons, and a chosen segment.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Highlighted panels and callouts in the page's layout; never behind body copy longer than a paragraph. A brand color: components don't use it (their hover fill is surface-hover).

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of secondary and ghost buttons and unchecked choice controls. Neutral gray, on bg and surface.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: The gray track behind a segmented control's options, with no visible edge. The chosen option sits on it in surface, with an ink border inside it.

tokens.name: track-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of an option on a track that isn't chosen.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on bg, surface, surface-tint, and surface-hover.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (meta, captions, placeholders) and decorative icons in fields, on bg, surface, surface-tint, and surface-hover.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card edges. Not for anything that must be seen to be used.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input, text area, and control borders, and the switch thumb when off; meets 3:1 on bg, surface, surface-tint, and surface-hover.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Neutral fill for controls: a primary button, a ticked checkbox, a selected radio, and an on switch. Near black in light and hot dog, near white in dark. Never a brand color, so components fit any brand; use brand in the layout instead.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for everything on action.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text, icons, and marks (tick, dot, switch thumb) on action and action-hover.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The brand color, for layouts: hero bands, feature panels, illustrations, and small flourishes. Components never use it, so they can sit on it. Measures 2.7:1 against bg in light, so it's never the only edge of something that must be seen.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand. Never white.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links and text buttons on bg, surface, and surface-tint.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, selection, and playful accents.

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Text on highlight.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus outline; 3:1 or more on every surface. Neutral, like the controls it surrounds.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on bg and surface. Always paired with an icon or word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success message background; text on it uses ink.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on bg and surface. Always paired with an icon or word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning message background; text on it uses ink.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and icons on bg and surface. Always paired with an icon or word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error message background; text on it uses ink.

leading.note: Line heights used on their own, outside a type style.

tokens.name: leading-control
tokens.usage: Text in text fields (Input, TextArea) and the labels of form controls and groups. At body size a line is 1.5rem, which centers in a control-md field.

families.mono: "Geist Mono Variable", "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page, the hero headline. Fluid: clamp(2.441rem, 1.749rem + 3.075vw, 4.209rem) (39px on phones, 67px on wide screens). The size shown is the widest-screen size.

styles.name: heading-xl
styles.usage: Page titles (h1). Fluid: clamp(1.953rem, 1.482rem + 2.094vw, 3.157rem) (31px on phones, 51px on wide screens). The size shown is the widest-screen size.

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Section headings (h2). Fluid: clamp(1.563rem, 1.248rem + 1.402vw, 2.369rem) (25px on phones, 38px on wide screens). The size shown is the widest-screen size.

styles.name: heading-md
styles.usage: Subsections and card titles (h3). Fluid: clamp(1.25rem, 1.044rem + 0.917vw, 1.777rem) (20px on phones, 28px on wide screens). The size shown is the widest-screen size.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: Small headings (h4) and dialog titles. Fluid: clamp(1.125rem, 1.044rem + 0.362vw, 1.333rem) (18px on phones, 21px on wide screens). The size shown is the widest-screen size.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: I build playful, useful things for the web.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Sometimes they're serious. Often they involve hot dogs.
styles.usage: Default for all running text. Keep lines near 65 characters (max-width: measure).

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Meta text, helper text under inputs, table cells.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows and tags. Never for sentences.

spacing.note: A 4px grid written in rem: space-N = N × 0.25rem, the same scale as Tailwind's spacing utilities (gap-6 = space-6 = 1.5rem).

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: 0px at default size. No space.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: 4px at default size. Hairline gaps: icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: 8px at default size. Tight gaps inside chips and button groups.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: 12px at default size. Text field (Input, TextArea) and small-button inner padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: 16px at default size. Default gap between related items; button horizontal padding; large text field inner padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: 20px at default size. Card padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: 24px at default size. Card padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: 32px at default size. Gap between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: 40px at default size. Large component padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: 48px at default size. Gap between sections on phones.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: 64px at default size. Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: 80px at default size. Large section breaks.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: 96px at default size. Page top and bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: 128px at default size. Hero spacing.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, keyboard keys, tiny tags.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons (the default rectangle shape), segmented controls, tooltips, menu items, small images.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Text fields (inputs and text areas), selects, popovers, menus, images in cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero panels and large feature blocks.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pill buttons, chips, badges, avatars, switches.

shadow.note: Shadows are neutral black, so they suit any brand. Hot dog mode swaps them for hard offset shadows. Forced-colors mode removes shadows, so never rely on one to show state.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs at rest, if raised.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Cards on hover, popovers, menus.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and drawers.

size.note: Component and layout sizes, in rem so they scale with the reader's font size. value is for a mouse or trackpad. A token with touch takes that value whenever a touch screen is present (or under data-pointer="coarse"); one with compact takes that value under data-density="compact", but never less than target-min.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for anything interactive, padding included: 24px with a mouse or trackpad (WCAG 2.2 AA), 44px whenever a touch screen is present (Apple, Fluent, and WCAG AAA).

tokens.name: target-gap
tokens.usage: Minimum space between separate small targets (8px), so a finger or slip of the mouse doesn't hit the neighbor.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and inputs in dense UI: 32px everywhere. On touch, the hit area is padded out to target-min.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button, input, and segmented control height: 40px with a mouse, 44px on touch.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Prominent actions and large fields: 48px with a mouse, 52px on touch.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside small text and chips.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size, beside body text and in buttons.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Icons in large buttons, navigation bars, and empty states (24px).

tokens.name: choice
tokens.usage: Checkbox and radio box size, and switch track height (24px). The label, or a hit-area pseudo-element, brings the target to target-min.

tokens.name: choice-row
tokens.usage: Height of each checkbox, radio, or switch row, label included: 32px with a mouse, 44px on touch. Rows stack with no gap.

tokens.name: segment-inset
tokens.usage: Gap between a segment's edge and its rounded highlight (the chosen option's fill and border, and the hover fill), so a little of the gray track shows around it (3px).

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of running text: about 65–75 characters. Never wider than 90.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of page content.

iconStroke.note: Line widths for outline icons such as Lucide's, in the icon's own 24-unit drawing, so they scale with the icon.

tokens.name: icon-stroke
tokens.usage: The usual line width of an icon, as Lucide draws it.

tokens.name: icon-stroke-bold
tokens.usage: The icon version of bold text: thicker lines for an icon that shows a state by itself, such as a pressed toolbar button in the RichText experiment.

borderWidth.note: Pixel values on purpose: hairlines should stay crisp, not grow with font size.

tokens.name: border-thin
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card edges, input borders.

tokens.name: border-thick
tokens.usage: Selected states, outline buttons, all borders in hot dog mode.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Focus outline width.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between an element and its focus outline.

breakpoint.note: Min-width breakpoints, written in em so they follow the reader's font size. Design mobile-first: start with one column and add layout as space allows.

tokens.name: breakpoint-sm
tokens.usage: 640px. Large phones in landscape and small tablets. Headings reach their larger sizes around here.

tokens.name: breakpoint-md
tokens.usage: 768px. Tablets in portrait. Two-column layouts become possible; page-level spacing steps up.

tokens.name: breakpoint-lg
tokens.usage: 1024px. Tablets in landscape and small laptops. Side navigation can stay open.

tokens.name: breakpoint-xl
tokens.usage: 1280px. Laptops and desktops. Content reaches content-max soon after.

tokens.name: breakpoint-2xl
tokens.usage: 1536px. Large desktop monitors. Add space, not more columns of text.
